findings.issue: Qal perfect 3fs is indicative (she turned/inclined). 'se hubiera inclinado' adds middle/reflexive voice and a counterfactual pluperfect subjunctive; the adverb perhaps does not license irrealis 'would have.'
Feminine plural H7272 is the noun feet; 'veces' selects the counted-occurrence sense and closes the concrete foot sense.
Demonstrative is masculine singular; 'estas' is feminine plural, smoothed to agree with 'veces.'

Qal perfect 'I killed' and hiphil perfect 'I made alive' become simple conditionals, so completed force shifts to present potential. The conditionals also fail to mark 1cs uniquely. Hiphil causation remains visible in 'dejar vivir.'
findings.spanishSpan: mataría, y a ella dejaría vivir

notes: Fail is the second H5186: reflexive counterfactual for a qal perfect.
